A different point of view

Some homes have a view.
This one lives by it.

Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the sea and skyline, bringing natural light into every corner of the living space. Warm materials and soft, neutral interiors leave room for the view to do the talking.

Across 2,200 sq ft, open-plan living meets three generous bedrooms. Fully furnished, thoughtfully arranged, and ready for your next chapter.
